scenarios.name: spot_mac01_snapchk
scenarios.subject: Toad Town mac_01, Mario placed at pos 0 0 200 (warp entry 0), cold det start with the snapchk switch (core 1 combine snap against core 0 compare at each mesh triangle).
scenarios.proves: NDR0A: the snapchk lines of the run (recs and cmp above 0; bad and fbad recorded, not judged). Base run of the merge-base for the byte compare.
scenarios.reason: NDR0A: copy of spot_mac01_dschk with snapchk in place of dschk. Cold start, cap 30 s, deadline 25 s. The snapchk f200 line is the until.
